summary_1line: Bhishma explains types of friends, cautious trust, qualities of ministers, and the complex role of kinsmen in royal policy.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while instructing Yudhishthira about kings, friends, and the dangers of misplaced trust.
A wary king sits in council, observing ministers and kinsmen around him while secretly weighing whom he can trust.
